nodes.label: regression_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Regression property tests for TemporalIndexer: verifies get_recent(0) returns empty and that inserting a trace preserves its UUID. Uses TemporalTrace and DecayType::Exponential.

nodes.label: self_model_props.rs
nodes.summary: Property-based tests for self-model intelligence layer invariants using proptest. Covers 8 invariants: health scores in [0,1], aggregated health in [0,1], resource predictions non-negative, EWMA latency stability, success rates in [0,1], decision confidence in [0,1], capability registry consistency, resource composition monotonicity, and health degradation detectability. Imports from hipcortex::self_model.

nodes.label: test_graph.rs
nodes.summary: Property test for SymbolicStore graph: verifies that chaining N nodes with 'next' edges produces correct neighbors for each consecutive pair. Uses proptest with count in 1..5.

nodes.label: world_model_props.rs
nodes.summary: Property-based tests for world_model_enhanced invariants using proptest. Covers: transition probability distributions summing to 1.0, entropy in valid range, causal graph acyclicity, transitive path consistency, Kalman covariance positive semi-definiteness, prediction uncertainty growth, confidence interval bounds, uncertainty propagation monotonicity, calibration error with data, and edge case handling (empty model, single observation). Imports from hipcortex::world_model_enhanced.

nodes.label: connectivity.rs
nodes.summary: Property test for SymbolicStore graph connectivity: builds a linear chain of nodes (count in 2..6), then BFS-verifies reachability from start to last node via 'next' edges.

nodes.label: fsm_reachability.rs
nodes.summary: Property test for ProceduralCache FSM reachability: verifies that the Start->Observe->Act->End transition sequence always reaches FSMState::End in exactly 3 advance() calls regardless of step count (1..5). Imports FSMState, FSMTransition, ProceduralCache, ProceduralTrace.

nodes.label: coherence_props.rs
nodes.summary: Property-based tests for coherence layer invariants. Covers: entity count conservation, creation-only conservation (no critical violations), decay monotonicity enforcement, decay decrease not flagged as violation, activation non-negativity, resolution leaving no active inconsistencies (Consensus/Recency/Confidence strategies), graph acyclicity check (no panic), cycle detection consistency, and full invariant enforcement returning valid InvariantType values. Imports CoherenceChecker, ResolutionStrategy, InvariantType, SystemInvariants.

nodes.label: mod.rs (property)
nodes.summary: Property test module registry. Declares submodules: coherence_props, connectivity, fsm_reachability, regression_tests, self_model_props, world_model_props, test_graph.

nodes.label: property_suite.rs
nodes.summary: Top-level property test binary entry point. Declares `mod property;` which pulls in the property test module tree. Registered as tests/property_suite in Cargo.toml.
